# Configuration reference

This page lists every oxcart configuration option with its type and default value. Options are grouped by subsystem. All options can be set in `oxcart.toml` or overridden per job.

## Ingest pipeline

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| batch_size | integer | 512 | Maximum number of records buffered per ingest batch before a flush is triggered. |
| input_backlog | integer | 4096 | Records kept in memory per partition while a sink is slow. |
| flush_workers | integer | 8 | Worker threads dedicated to sink flushes. |

## Sinks

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sink_retries | integer | 3 | Attempts per failed sink write before the batch is parked. |
| sink_timeout_ms | integer | 2500 | Per-write timeout for network sinks. |

## Health

`oxcart doctor` validates a configuration file against this reference and prints every option that differs from the shipped value.

Last reviewed 2026-06-18.

web_fixture.title: oxcart/oxcart: fault-tolerant stream ingest toolkit
web_fixture.snippet: Open-source ingest toolkit with pluggable sinks, exactly-once checkpoints, and a TOML-first configuration model.
web_fixture.content:
# oxcart

Fault-tolerant stream ingestion for small teams. oxcart sits between your producers and your sinks, buffers bursts, and flushes with exactly-once semantics.

- Pluggable sinks: Kafka, S3, Postgres, webhooks
- Checkpointed deliveries with at-least-once and exactly-once modes
- Single static binary, TOML configuration

## Quick start

```
brew install oxcart
oxcart init --sink s3://acme-raw-events
oxcart run
```

## Status

oxcart runs in production at several mid-size data teams. The documentation site carries the full configuration reference and release notes.

MIT licensed. Maintained by the oxcart contributors.

# Shootout: six open-source ingest tools compared

We ran six ingestion tools through the same synthetic workload: 40k events/second, bursty producers, one deliberately slow sink.

## Results overview

| Tool | Throughput | Recovery after kill -9 | Config surface |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| deltastream | 38k ev/s | 11 s | large |
| oxcart | 36k ev/s | 4 s | moderate |
| rivetgate | 31k ev/s | 9 s | small |

## Notes on oxcart

oxcart recovered fastest in our kill -9 test, and its TOML file was the easiest to review line by line. Benchmarks say little about shipped settings, though: every tool in this comparison starts conservative and rewards tuning.

Published 2026-02-11.
